scope: Static validation of desired PCI device/function values against the actual mapper allowlist; not a link-training or lane-routing test.

exact_match_policy.producer: AmdNbioEarlyPhaseRVPei enables it for SMU high bits2/3.
exact_match_policy.candidate_change: None. CPU silicon classification and the associated policy remain unchanged.
exact_match_policy.unresolved: The behavior of the signed SMU firmware under this policy was not emulated.

post_comparison_ordering_review.observed_mapper_behavior: The mapper validates the requested device/function against seven allowed values, rejects duplicates, and stores it at an engine-provided port index. This routine does not compare lane start numbers or enforce ascending logical-lane order.
post_comparison_ordering_review.observed_writer_behavior: The following routine preserves assigned values, fills unassigned slots, and programs the mapping using register sequences starting at0x13b100c0 and0x11140008.
post_comparison_ordering_review.limit: These routines require a valid engine/port structure from the preceding initialization. They do not prove that SMU accepts the candidate lane allocation or exact-match policy on V1500B.
post_comparison_ordering_review.source_comment_interpretation: The separate Picasso header ordering comment is not a demonstrated rejection in this target mapper. Keep it as context for full-path validation, not an established Raven prohibition.
